ownershipBoundaries.scope: Read original executed prototype source and log, no rerun

proposalFindings: Exact owned PID/start/parent/executable hash before attach and after attach-stop, with expected TracerPid, is appropriate; parent must not reap during first attach handshake.

4 SIGSEGV events x 4 threads x 12 frames is below the permitted 8-thread/16-frame ceiling. Original handled/fatal and direct-detach experiments support the proposed signal semantics on the tested local GDB only.

The proposal explicitly limits stored output to address/function and controlled executable module offsets, excludes args/locals/environment/core/arbitrary memory, and disables GDB auto-load and debuginfod before attach.
Debugger attachment is an intervention. Original owned wait status remains the terminal-status evidence; a stack or attach success cannot independently imply QEMU root cause or native gameplay pass.
implementationAcceptanceStillRequired: All poll/wait/finally/signal paths preserve the no-reap handshake, including target exits before or during attach.
Same executable GDB bytes and actual GDB version must pass controlled signal/detach fixtures in CI before the real QEMU hook; sudo path must bind actual tracer PID/start/exe rather than wrapper PID.
Timeout/output/parse failures must retain a bounded normal detach attempt and explicit uncertainty; no blind debugger/target kill or signal swallowing.
Only whitelisted sanitized frame fields may be archived; asynchronous, console, source path, args and arbitrary raw MI lines must not enter exported diagnostics.
Original v8 APK, Observer, API, SDK version, argv, memory/GPU/Vulkan settings and QA assertions remain unchanged; opt-in default stays off.
